title: Star Trek cast members at the 1976 Space Shuttle Enterprise rollout
alt_text: NASA Space Shuttle Enterprise orbiter behind a group of NASA officials and Star Trek cast and creators at its 1976 public rollout.
caption: At the September 17, 1976 public rollout of NASA's real Space Shuttle Enterprise at Palmdale, Star Trek cast members joined NASA officials. This historical photograph is not a Star Trek film or television frame.
credit_line: Photograph: NASA. Independent research archive; not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA. Read NASA's original source.
